title: ProfessionItemSubstitutionsDef
description:
A profession item substitution definition from JSON type `"profession_item_substitutions"`.

Defines substitutions for items in profession starting equipment based on character traits (e.g. replacing wool items for characters with wool allergy).

The JSON data may identify the item using `"item"`, `"trait"`, or `"group"` instead of `"id"`, so all identifier fields are optional.

id.description: Unique identifier (the item id being substituted).
